zh-CN.name: Bookmark Sync
zh-CN.shortDescription: 通过端到端加密在 Chrome / Edge / Firefox 间同步书签
zh-CN.summary: 跨 Chrome / Edge / Firefox 的书签云同步：端到端加密，多设备保持同一棵书签树
zh-CN.description:
通过端到端加密在 Chrome / Edge / Firefox 间同步书签

Bookmark Sync 让 Chrome、Edge、Firefox 三款浏览器的书签汇成同一棵树。在每个浏览器里登录同一账号，书签、文件夹与排列顺序在所有设备上保持一致——不用导出导入文件，不用自建服务器，端到端加密默认开启。

浏览器自带的同步只管自己那一家。Bookmark Sync 是它们之间的桥：在公司用 Chrome 整理，回家打开 Firefox，东西已经在那儿了。

【为什么换用它】

· 跨浏览器：Chrome / Edge / Firefox 之间双向同步书签与文件夹。在任意一台设备上新增、改名、移动或重排，其他设备跟着变。

· 真树同步，不是拍平的路径：文件夹保留真实的层级与顺序。重命名或移动文件夹不会让子项失联，你拖出来的顺序就是每台设备上的顺序。

· 端到端加密，默认开启：每一次改动都在你的设备上用 AES-256-GCM 加密后才发出。服务器只保管密文，我们和其他任何人都读不到你的书签。新设备输一个同步口令即可解密——不用记长串密钥。

· 合并，而不是覆盖：两台设备同时增、删、改时，各自的新增都保留，谁也不会盲目覆盖对方；离线期间的改动联网后自动并入。这里没有需要你回答的冲突弹窗，也没有需要你重做的改动——合并结果由数据本身决定，每台设备最终落到同一个状态。

· 删掉就是删掉：删除以墓碑跨设备传播，笔记本上删掉的书签不会因为台式机上的旧数据又冒出来。

· 空间隔离：每个空间是一棵独立的书签树，工作与生活永不混淆（Free 1 个 / Plus 3 个 / Pro 10 个）。

· 设备管理：每个参与同步的浏览器都会登记，随时可以改名或解绑。

【怎么开始】

1. 在你用的每个浏览器里安装扩展。
2. 用同一账号登录，设置同步口令。
3. 就这样——完整书签树会自动拉下来并保持同步。

【定价】

永久免费：1,000 条书签、1 个空间、3 台设备，无需信用卡。Plus（$20/年）：10,000 条书签、3 个空间、6 台设备。Pro（$50/年）：书签不限（约 25 万条封顶）、10 个空间、15 台设备。三档的同步功能完全一致——只为容量付费。

【隐私与安全】

· 端到端加密默认开启，服务器无法读取书签内容
· 仅收集登录邮箱与同步所需的最小数据
· 隐私政策：https://www.bookmark-sync.top/privacy

【常见问题】

问：需要注册账号吗？
答：需要。用邮箱 + 密码注册，再设置同步口令即可开始同步。

问：支持哪些浏览器？
答：Chrome、Edge、Firefox（Manifest V3）。Safari 不提供 bookmarks API，暂不支持。

问：可以免费用吗？
答：可以——1,000 条书签永久免费，同步功能与付费版完全一致。

问：新设备上怎么恢复书签？
答：安装扩展、登录同一账号、输入同一个同步口令，完整书签树会自动拉取。

问：两台设备改了同一个书签会怎样？
答：自动合并——两边的新增都保留，不会因为盲目覆盖而丢失。若两台设备移动或重命名了同一个条目，所有设备最终收敛到同一个结果，不需要你手动选择。

问：忘记同步口令怎么办？
答：口令在你的设备上派生密钥，从不上传，它是唯一能解密数据的东西。丢失后云端密文无法恢复，请把它存进密码管理器。

问：我的数据安全吗？
答：所有内容在上传前就在你的设备上加密，服务器只保存密文，即使泄露也读不到你的书签。

en-US.name: Bookmark Sync
en-US.shortDescription: Sync bookmarks across Chrome, Edge and Firefox with end-to-end encryption
en-US.summary: Cross-browser bookmark sync for Chrome / Edge / Firefox with end-to-end encryption. Keep one bookmark tree across all your devices.
en-US.description:
Sync bookmarks across Chrome, Edge and Firefox with end-to-end encryption

Bookmark Sync keeps one bookmark tree across Chrome, Edge, and Firefox. Sign in with the same account in each browser and your bookmarks, folders, and ordering stay identical everywhere—no export/import files, no self-hosted server, and end-to-end encryption on by default.

Your browser's built-in sync only covers its own vendor. Bookmark Sync is the bridge between them: organize on Chrome at the office, open Firefox at home, and everything is already there.

WHY PEOPLE SWITCH TO IT

· Cross-browser by design: Two-way sync of bookmarks and folders between Chrome / Edge / Firefox. Add, rename, move, or reorder on one device and the others follow.

· True tree sync, not flattened paths: Folders keep their real hierarchy and order. Renaming or moving a folder never orphans its children, and the order you arrange is the order you get on every device.

· End-to-end encryption, on by default: Every change is encrypted on your device with AES-256-GCM before it leaves. The server stores ciphertext only, so neither we nor anyone else can read your bookmarks. One sync passphrase unlocks a new device—no long key to memorize.

· Merges instead of overwriting: Add, rename, move, or delete on two devices at once—both sides' additions are kept and neither device blindly overwrites the other. Offline changes merge once you are back online. There is no conflict dialog to answer and no edit to redo: the merge is decided by the data itself, so every device lands on the same result.

· Deletions that stay deleted: Removals propagate as tombstones, so a bookmark you deleted on your laptop will not reappear from stale data on your desktop.

· Spaces to separate work and life: Each space is an independent bookmark tree that never mixes (1 on Free, 3 on Plus, 10 on Pro).

· Device control: Every browser that syncs is listed; rename or unbind any of them whenever you want.

HOW TO START

1. Install the extension in each browser you use.
2. Sign in with the same account and set a sync passphrase.
3. That is it—your full bookmark tree is pulled down and kept in sync from then on.

PRICING

Free forever: 1000 bookmarks, 1 space, 3 devices, no credit card. Plus ($20/year): 10,000 bookmarks, 3 spaces, 6 devices. Pro ($50/year): unlimited bookmarks (about 250,000 cap), 10 spaces, 15 devices. Every tier has the exact same sync features—you only ever pay for capacity.

PRIVACY & SECURITY

· End-to-end encryption enabled by default; the server cannot read your bookmark content
· Collects only your sign-in email and the minimum data needed for sync
· Privacy policy: https://www.bookmark-sync.top/privacy

FAQ

Q: Do I need an account?
A: Yes. Register with an email and password, then set a sync passphrase to start syncing.

Q: Which browsers are supported?
A: Chrome, Edge, and Firefox (Manifest V3). Safari does not expose a bookmarks API, so it is not supported.

Q: Can I use it for free?
A: Yes—1000 bookmarks forever, with the same sync features as paid plans.

Q: How do I restore my bookmarks on a new device?
A: Install the extension, sign in with the same account, and enter the same sync passphrase. Your full bookmark tree is pulled automatically.

Q: What happens if two devices change the same bookmark?
A: They are merged automatically—additions from both devices are kept, and nothing is lost to a blind overwrite. If both devices move or rename the exact same item, every device converges to the same result, with nothing for you to resolve.

Q: What if I forget my sync passphrase?
A: The passphrase derives your key locally and is never uploaded—it is the only thing that can decrypt your data. If you lose it, the ciphertext in the cloud cannot be recovered, so keep it in a password manager.

Q: Is my data safe?
A: Everything is encrypted on your device before upload. The server only ever holds ciphertext, so even a leak would not expose your bookmarks.
